macros.name: macrolistadd
macros.doc: To add something to the list listname, pass in \macrolistadd{listname}[position]{element}, where position is an optional argument.

macros.name: macrolistadd
macros.doc: To add something to the list listname, pass in \macrolistadd{listname}[position]{element}, where position is an optional argument.

macros.name: macrolistcontains
macros.doc: Writing \macrolistcontains{listname}{element}{true branch}{false branch} checks whether list listname contains element, executing true branch if it does and false branch if it does not.

macros.name: macrolistelement
macros.doc: To execute the ith element of listname, write \macrolistelement{listname}{i}.

macros.name: macrolistexists
macros.doc: Writing \macrolistexists{listname}{true}{false} will execute true if listname exists and false otherwise.

macros.name: macrolistindexof
macros.doc: Write \macrolistindexof{list}{element} to get the index of where element first appears in list.

macros.name: macrolistjoin
macros.doc: Executing \macrolistjoin{listname}{joiner} returns all of the elements separated by joiner.

macros.name: macrolistremove
macros.doc: To remove an element in a list, write \macrolistremove{listname}{index}.

macros.name: macrolistremovelast
macros.doc: To remove the last element in a list, write \macrolistremovelast{listname}.

macros.name: macrolistsize
macros.doc: To get the size of a list, write \macrolistsize{listname}.

macros.name: macronewlist
macros.doc: To create a list, pass in \macronewlist{listname} to create a list with the name listname.
